MIN / MAX：最小・最大

words.display:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name text NOT NULL,
  email text UNIQUE,
  age integer CHECK (age >= 0),
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  department_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  profile jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id),
  amount numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
words.input: CREATE TABLE users (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, email text UNIQUE, age integer CHECK (age >= 0), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, department_id bigint, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), profile jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'); CREATE TABLE orders (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id bigint REFERENCES users(id), amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());
words.annotation: サンプルテーブル：例に使う表を作成（空の検証用スキーマ向け。同名表があると失敗。以下の例を全部順番に実行する用途ではない）

words.input: PREPARE find_user(bigint) AS SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1; EXECUTE find_user(1); DEALLOCATE find_user;
words.annotation: $1等のパラメーター：値をパラメーター化（アプリではドライバーのパラメーターAPIを使用。識別子は値パラメーターでは置き換えられない）

words.input: SELECT DISTINCT ON (department_id) department_id, id, created_at FROM users ORDER BY department_id, created_at DESC, id DESC;
words.annotation: DISTINCT ON：グループごとに先頭行（PostgreSQL固有。DISTINCT ON式をORDER BYの左端に合わせる）

words.display:
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*)
FROM users
GROUP BY department_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
words.input: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

words.input: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_count FROM users;

words.input: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

FROM users u
FULL
OUTER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (
  VALUES (1)

  FROM nums

SELECT n
FROM nums;

words.display:
SELECT u.id, recent.id AS order_id
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.user_id = u.id
  ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

words.input: SELECT id, user_id, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS user_total FROM orders;

words.input: SELECT id, LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, id) FROM orders;

words.input: SELECT id, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM orders;

words.input: DECLARE v_name VARCHAR2(100); BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT name FROM users WHERE id=:id' INTO v_name USING 1; END;
words.annotation: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE / USING：パラメーター付き動的SQL（値をバインド。識別子の未検証連結を避ける）

words.input: BEGIN SAVEPOINT before_change; UPDATE users SET name='New' WHERE id=1; ROLLBACK TO before_change; END;
words.annotation: COMMIT / ROLLBACK / SAVEPOINT：確定・取消・復帰地点（例は更新を戻す。DDLは暗黙COMMITが生じるため別扱い）

words.input: DECLARE v_id users.id%TYPE; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_id FROM users WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE; END;
words.annotation: SELECT FOR UPDATE：行をロック（ブロック終了だけでは取引終了しない。COMMIT/ROLLBACKまで保持）

words.input: DECLARE v_age PLS_INTEGER:=20; c_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER:=100; BEGIN v_age:=21; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_age); END;
words.annotation: := / CONSTANT：変数・定数（ローカル変数の既定値は通常NULL）

words.input: DECLARE v_amount NUMBER(12,2):=123.45; v_ok BOOLEAN:=TRUE; BEGIN IF v_ok THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_amount); END IF; END;
words.annotation: NUMBER / VARCHAR2 / DATE / BOOLEAN：主な型（19cのBOOLEANはPL/SQL内。SQL列へのBOOLEAN対応は新しい版と区別）

words.input: DECLARE v_role VARCHAR2(20):='admin'; BEGIN CASE v_role WHEN 'admin' THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('管理者'); ELSE DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('その他'); END CASE; END;
words.annotation: CASE：値による分岐（文と式のCASEを区別）

words.input: DECLARE v_name VARCHAR2(100); BEGIN SELECT name INTO v_name FROM users WHERE id=1; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_name); END;
words.annotation: SELECT INTO：1行を変数へ取得（users表が必要。0行・複数行で例外）

words.input: DECLARE v_id NUMBER; BEGIN INSERT INTO users(name) VALUES('Pomo') RETURNING id INTO v_id; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_id); END;
words.annotation: INSERT / RETURNING INTO：追加値を受け取る（users.idの採番等を準備。自動COMMITしない）

words.input: DECLARE CURSOR c_users IS SELECT name FROM users; BEGIN FOR r IN c_users LOOP DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.name); END LOOP; END;
words.annotation: 明示カーソル：カーソルを宣言

words.input: DECLARE CURSOR c IS SELECT name FROM users; v_name users.name%TYPE; BEGIN OPEN c; LOOP FETCH c INTO v_name; EXIT WHEN c%NOTFOUND; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_name); END LOOP; CLOSE c; END;
words.annotation: OPEN FETCH CLOSE：明示的に行取得（実運用では例外時の解放も考慮）

words.input: DECLARE TYPE names_t IS TABLE OF VARCHAR2(100) INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER; names names_t; BEGIN names(1):='Pomo'; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(names.COUNT); END;
words.annotation: 連想配列：キー付き配列（添字が密に連続するとは限らない）

words.input: DECLARE TYPE ids_t IS TABLE OF users.id%TYPE; ids ids_t; BEGIN SELECT id BULK COLLECT INTO ids FROM users; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(ids.COUNT); END;
words.annotation: BULK COLLECT：複数行を一括取得（大量取得はメモリ消費。FETCH BULK COLLECT LIMIT等も検討）

words.input: DECLARE TYPE ids_t IS TABLE OF NUMBER; ids ids_t:=ids_t(1,2,3); BEGIN FORALL i IN 1..ids.COUNT UPDATE users SET name='New' WHERE id=ids(i); END;

words.input: DECLARE v_name users.name%TYPE; BEGIN SELECT name INTO v_name FROM users WHERE id=1; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('なし'); WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN RAISE; END;

words.input: BEGIN RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(SQLCODE || ':' || SQLERRM); RAISE; END;

DISTINCT：重複排除

words.display: DELETE FROM dbo.Orders OUTPUT DELETED.Id WHERE Id = 1;
words.input: DELETE FROM dbo.Orders OUTPUT DELETED.Id WHERE Id = 1;

words.display: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users ORDER BY Id OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY;

words.display: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1 AND Age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 AND Id IN (1, 2, 3);
words.input: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1 AND Age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 AND Id IN (1,2,3);

words.display:
SELECT *
FROM dbo.Users u
WHERE EXISTS (

  FROM dbo.Orders o
  WHERE o.UserId = u.Id
);

words.input: SELECT Id, UserId, Amount, SUM(Amount) OVER (PARTITION BY UserId) AS Total FROM dbo.Orders;

words.annotation: LAG / LEAD：前後の行を参照

words.input: ALTER TABLE dbo.Users ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Users_Age CHECK (Age >= 0);

words.display: CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_UserId ON dbo.Orders(UserId) INCLUDE (Amount);
words.input: CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_UserId ON dbo.Orders(UserId) INCLUDE (Amount);

datetime2 / datetimeoffset / uniqueidentifier：日時・UUID（datetime2はタイムゾーンを保持しない）

words.input: DECLARE @i int=0; WHILE @i<3 BEGIN IF @i=1 PRINT N'one'; SET @i+=1; END;

words.input: CREATE TABLE dbo.Users (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, Name nvarchar(100) NOT NULL, Email nvarchar(255) UNIQUE, Age int NULL, Active bit NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, CreatedAt datetime2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME()); CREATE TABLE dbo.Orders (Id int IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, UserId int REFERENCES dbo.Users(Id), Amount decimal(12,2) NOT NULL);

) recent;

;WITH Totals AS (

)

words.input: SET XACT_ABORT ON; BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION; UPDATE dbo.Users SET Active=0 WHERE Id=1; COMMIT TRANSACTION; END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION; THROW; END CATCH;
